window_selection.rule: 90 full UTC days immediately before R02; metadata and quality only, never profitability
window_selection.failure_policy: stop; preserve gaps and missing evidence; no window shopping

risk.reference_quantity_rule: At first closed bar p0: floor(min(1, 1000 / (p0 * (1 + slippage) * (1 + fee)))) to 0.01. Split into orders <=0.1; all obey common cash/reservation/volume limits, earliest next completed bar; no future resizing.
risk.interpretation: common ex-ante quantity/capital risk scale, not equal realized exposure or hard mark-to-market notional cap

funding: NOT_IN_PAPER_LEDGER; event-specific sensitivity separately, never combined into certified NAV
execution_gate: complete new-window hourly identity and quality
bounded R04B adapter for two-arm matrix and common-budget reference
preregistration content hash recorded before any economic result
